description: This file contains PHP classes implementing MIME handling for SOAP web services, including support for MIME attachments in SOAP requests and responses via classes 'soapclient2mime' and 'nusoapservermime'. It manages MIME attachments, encodes/decodes MIME multipart messages, and integrates with PEAR Mail_MIME library.

classes.name: soapclient2mime
classes.description: Client class supporting MIME attachments in SOAP requests and responses.

classes.name: nusoapservermime
classes.description: Server class supporting MIME attachments in SOAP responses and processing MIME in requests.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a MIME attachment to the current request or response, generating CID if not provided.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Clears all MIME attachments from the current request or response.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves current MIME attachments from request or response.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTTP body, including MIME parts, for the SOAP message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate Content-Type header for the MIME message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset for the Content-Type, or false if not applicable.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Processes MIME multipart/related responses, extracting attachments.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Processes MIME multipart/related requests, extracting attachments.
